test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Because of his caring nature he is appreciated by all.

options.text: Because of his caring nature all appreciate him.
Because of his caring nature everyone appreciate him.
Because of his caring nature all will appreciate him.
Because of his caring nature all appreciated him.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Because of his caring nature all appreciate him.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in passive voice.
 
• While changing the Passive voice sentence into Active voice sentence we need to know the structure of the Active voice and Passive voice sentences -
 
 
• **Active voice: Subject + Verb + Object**
 
• **Passive voice: Object + Helping verb + Verb (3rd form) + Subject**
 
 
 
• In the given sentence the **main sentence** is** "he is appreciated by all".**
 
• In the given sentence, the word, **"he" **is the** object (objective case)** while** "all"** is the subject **(subjective case)**.
 
• Compare the** main sentence** with the structure of the Passive voice sentence. "<
